task_title: enforce deploy rotation: check-deploy as a tick close-out gate
task_criteria: A stale deployed binary cannot survive a tick silently: the tick close-out (Makefile target invoked by the foreman/round-up, or a cron check) runs check-deploy and FAILS until ./off-by-one is rebuilt from HEAD and the service is serving it; proven by leaving the tree stale once and showing the gate red, then green after make build + service restart; api-reference/README state the rebuild step next to the run instructions

tier2.summary:
COMPLETE
  ✓ A stale deployed binary cannot survive a tick silently: the tick close-out (Makefile target invoked by the foreman/round-up, or a cron check) runs check-deploy and FAILS until ./off-by-one is rebuilt from HEAD and the service is serving it; proven by leaving the tree stale once and showing the gate red, then green after make build + service restart; api-reference/README state the rebuild step next to the run instructions: Makefile:107-108 defines the tick close-out target `gate-deploy:` -> ./scripts/gate-deploy, which runs scripts/check-deploy and adopts its exit status as the gate verdict (Leg D: "$CHECK"; rc=$?; rc!=0 -> FAIL exit 1 with remedy); it is fail-closed (missing probe = FAIL, not-a-checkout = FAIL, unit bound elsewhere = FAIL, worktree/foreign host = loud SKIP). LIVE RED PROOF on the real tree: `make gate-deploy` -> "ERROR: ./off-by-one is stale — source changed since it was built; run 'make build'" / "check-deploy: FAIL — leg 1" / "gate-deploy: FAIL — the running off-by-one service does not serve HEAD's code" / make Error 1 (exit 1). LIVE GREEN PROOF: after `make build` (stamp 8df11f1) + `kill <MainPID>` (systemd Restart=always relaunched, new pid 1724369) -> "check-deploy: PASS — running service (pid 1724369, stamp 8df11f1) serves HEAD's code" / "gate-deploy: PASS — artifact and running service both serve HEAD's code; deploy rotation satisfied for tick close-out." (exit 0). Hermetic regression self-test `make check-deploy-test` -> "check-deploy-test: all assertions passed" (exit 0), covering "gate RED on a stale artifact (exit 1, remedy named)", "gate RED on an unstamped artifact", "gate GREEN after rebuild from HEAD against the throwaway instance (exit 0)", worktree SKIP, missing-probe FAIL, unit-bound-elsewhere FAIL, not-a-checkout FAIL. Docs state the rebuild step next to the run instructions: README.md:324-332 ("Rebuild after ANY code commit (deploy rotation)" ... "Run `make gate-deploy` before closing out a tick; it fails until ./off-by-one is rebuilt from HEAD and the service is serving it. Remedy: make build, then kill <MainPID> ... then make gate-deploy again") and README.md:360-373 ("Deploy the tick's changes (mandatory close-out step)"); docs/api-reference.md:687-719 (gate-deploy + remedy block + verdict table); docs/dogfood/diagnostics.md:320-400 ("Tick close-out enforcement (OB-GAP-085)" with red/green transcripts); skills/off-by-one-usage/SKILL.md:139-172. Test evidence: `go test -short -count=1 ./...` -> 13 pkgs ok, exit 0; CI runs `make check-deploy-test` (.github/workflows/ci.yml:104).
The tick close-out gate `make gate-deploy` (Makefile -> scripts/gate-deploy -> scripts/check-deploy) is fail-closed and was proven red on the stale tree and green after make build + service restart, with the rebuild step documented in README, api-reference, diagnostics and the skill file.
